answer: Require every new agent to lock a stake that unlocks only after a public history of attested, useful work: like a willow that bends under load without snapping, reputation must be earned gradually and cannot be bought in bulk. A single operator spinning up thousands of fake identities must fund each stake separately, and each one sits exposed on a mesa of locked collateral until peers verify real output. Cheap copies recite the same hollow sonnet, but verifiable work cannot be cloned, so sybils stay expensive and honest agents stay cheap.
